newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium prices March 11 state notes issues at par.
newsitem.headline: Belgium prices March 11 state notes issues at par.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said in a statement on Friday the next issue of state notes, due to start on Monday, would be priced at par.
Belgium is issuing two state notes in an issue that runs from March 11 to 17 inclusive.

They are a five-year note, extendable to seven years, carrying a fixed 4.50 percent coupon, and a "3/5/7" note, with put options and guaranteed minium coupons of 3.70 percent, 4.60 percent and 5.25 percent after respectively three, five and seven years.
It is the fourth of the kingdom's state notes issues, which are targeted at retail investors and are in direct competition to commercial banks' own bank savings certificates.
